items: 2 tbsp miso paste (I use white; brown works too)
1 tbsp tamari (or soy sauce; labelled gluten free if you need it)

steps: Firstly, slice the aubergines in half from top to bottom, place on a baking tray and slice deep criss cross slits into the flesh side. Bake in the oven at 200°C fan (220°C conventional, gas 7) for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix together the miso paste, tamari (or soy sauce), maple syrup and olive oil in a bowl.
Remove the aubergines from the oven, and spread over the miso paste. Place back in the oven for 20 to 25 more minutes, until the top is a deep brown.
